steps.sql: SELECT REPLICATE('abcd',0) AS a,REPLICATE(N'ab',0) AS n,REPLICATE(N'ab',-1) AS neg,REPLICATE(N'',0) AS empty,REPLICATE(CAST(N'x' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),0) AS m
SELECT REPLICATE('x',1+2) AS arithmetic,REPLICATE('x',CAST(3 AS INT)) AS converted,REPLICATE('x',+3) AS plus
DECLARE @s VARCHAR(10)='x'; SELECT REPLICATE(@s,3) AS declared
SELECT DATALENGTH(REPLICATE('xx',2147483647)) AS large, DATALENGTH(REPLICATE(N'🦆',2147483647)) AS n
SELECT DATALENGTH(REPLICATE('abc',2667)) AS a,RIGHT(REPLICATE('abc',2667),5) AS tail,DATALENGTH(REPLICATE(N'abc',1334)) AS n,RIGHT(REPLICATE(N'abc',1334),5) AS ntail
